name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon rests half-submerged in a still tide pool, coils draped over a mound of treasure, head raised and turned toward the camera with a calm, regal gaze, water streaming from its wings.
components.effects: A few droplets of water hang in the air, faint bioluminescent light rippling across the hoard - understated, nothing busy.
